basic_profile.name: Ravi Kabra
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder, Director Skippi | India’s First Icepops Brand With All-6-Sharks Deal | Shark Tank India’s Most Popular Brand | BW 40 under 40
basic_profile.summary:
Growing up, “Chuski” was more than just a treat – it was a feeling. The nostalgia of those colorful, icy delights sparked a vision: to bring back the joy of ice pops, but with a healthier, 100% natural twist. That’s how Skippi Ice Pops was born – India’s first-ever clean-label, natural ice popsicle brand, co-founded with my wife, Anuja.

With 19+ years in the Food & Beverage industry, my focus has always been on innovation, consumer trust, and quality. Skippi’s journey took a major leap when we became the only startup on Shark Tank India Season 1 to secure an all-shark deal – a testament to our vision and product excellence.

🚀 Our Growth Story:

- 60x revenue growth since Shark Tank

- 300+ team members driving our mission forward

- Expanding our footprint across India and beyond

current.employee_description:
Skippi Icepops is India's First Icepops brand which is selling across organized retail stores across India. In just 6 months of its launch we have already placed our brand across 1500 stores across India and many more are to come in the next few months. Skippi Icepops are made from 100% Natural Flavours and Colours with our Patent Pending Technology. 

We are the only Icepops brand selling on online marketplaces such as Amazon, Zepto, BlinkIt, Jio Mart, Swiggy Insta Mart and are capturing new market in the US$ 6 Billion Ice cream industry in India!

George Weston Foods makes some of Australia & New Zealand's favourite & most innovative products, living our core purpose ‘to delight people every day with the food they love!'We are one of Australia and New Zealand's largest food manufacturers employing over 6000 people across 60 sites. Our product range is diverse & includes leading brands such as Tip Top, Sunblest, Abbotts Bakery, Burgen, Golden, DON, KR Castlemaine, Yumi's as well as Mauri (flour, milled products, animal feed) and cleaning & hygiene solutions (Jasol).Our operating model encourages an entrepreneurial spirit, where people have the autonomy to create and deliver within their business.  Our authentic and inspiring leaders support and challenge us to deliver extraordinary performance, where you’re rewarded for both ‘what’ you achieve and ‘how’ you achieve it.  We love to say ‘thank you’, celebrating our people for their contribution to business results and living our values.  We’re committed to safety for everyone, everyday; and value diversity and inclusion as a way of delivering better outcomes.  GWF is a wholly owned subsidiary of Associated British Foods plc, a diversified international food, ingredients and retail group with sales of £15.4bn, 133,000 employees and operations in 50 countries around the world. Being part of a global food business offers our people many ways to grow and progress their career.http://www.gwf.com.au/ | https://www.abf.co.uk/

past.employer_linkedin_description: With more than 82,000 employees at almost 1,300 sites in close to 100 countries, the Kuehne+Nagel Group is one of the world's leading logistics providers. Headquartered in Switzerland, Kuehne+Nagel is listed in the Swiss blue-chip stock market index, the SMI. The Group is the global number one in air and sea logistics and has strong market positions in road and contract logistics. Kuehne+Nagel is the logistics partner of choice for 400,000 customers worldwide. Using its global network, logistics expertise and data-based insights, the Group provides end-to-end supply chain solutions for global companies and industries.
past.employee_description:
Leading the Commodity desk for Kuehne Nagel Australia, my core responsibility is to grow the containerized movements of commodities through customer acquisition, tailored and packaged process of service and sharp rates across through to all commodity exporters of Australian region. 

With my focus and reach pan Australia, I am able to offer enhanced serviceability and customer centric  solutions to the commodity industry.
